Tool reference
GitHub

Search without keys

DuckDuckGo, Brave and Bing RSS with reciprocal-rank fusion; automatic fallbacks when engines fight back.

Read with comprehension

fetch_page takes a query — BM25-ranked passages instead of the page head. web_search deep mode attaches excerpts to results.

Markdown, not soup

Density-scored article detection converts pages to structured markdown. Site adapters route GitHub, Stack Overflow, HN, Reddit and Wikipedia to their clean free APIs.

Honest by construction

SSRF-guarded, rate-limit-respecting, disk-backed caches, and it tells you when a fetch failed instead of inventing content.
